entities.summary: Magnus Karl Olof Arvedson is a Swedish former professional ice hockey left winger who played seven seasons in the National Hockey League for the Ottawa Senators and Vancouver Canucks. He also competed in the men's ice hockey tournament at the 2002 Winter Olympics.
